browser_smoke: Demo Run analysis -> live workspace opens; Inspector selects primary critical item; EVALUATE/TRIAGE are visible in Decision history.
Click another graph card -> Inspector changes to that card.
Click Focus primary risk -> Inspector returns to primary risk.
Click Propose repair -> Inspector moves to accepted conclusion while primary risk remains highlighted.
Seeded proposal appears in Revision Proposal with Accepted now, Proposed revision, editable draft, Accept proposal, Accept edited, Reject, Defer.
Accept -> old conclusion becomes SUPERSEDED/dim, new conclusion becomes ACCEPTED/selected, Decision history adds SUPERSEDE and ACCEPT_REVISION.
Custom Run analysis -> live workspace opens and produces visible selection/audit feedback.
Custom WebMCP triage -> EVALUATE/TRIAGE select ordered semantic primary risk.
Custom Propose repair -> inspect_workspace reports primary_risk_id and repair_target_id; WebMCP propose_revision fills Revision Proposal.
